verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a manual 'Create PR' button in the diff viewer, plus completion notifications. Automations produce a live workspace for human review, not an auto-opened PR. Nothing documents a setting that opens a pull request automatically when an agent's task finishes; the SDK, CLI and MCP are building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
